slug: do_emmetts_dream_of_llamanian_sheep
title: Do Emmetts Dream of Llamanian Sheep?
blurb: A ship-wide blackout leaves Emmett on the end of Sanya's leash, and a feverish withdrawal dream pulls him into a surreal park of weddings, bees and old fears.
authors: Trey, Zander, Brody
season: FF3
format: prose
---

The ship fell silent the night the power went out. It was as if the crew needed electricity to remain social, which is a bit surprising given their close interactions. Somehow, everyone forgot about supplying the ship with dark matter, and very slowly power drained. They were essentially dead weight, aside from the backup generators, which were only to be used to thrust the ship in the direction of a fueling station. Like a spell, the lack of lighting made everyone pretty tired. Seth, Vargas, Valentina, and your mom all went to their rooms, leaving our star pilot alone within the den. Emmett was reading a book upon one of the many sofas before the power went out, so he was a little irritated.

"[Well, that's great. Anyone got a light? I'm currently in the middle of something]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett groaned into his comms. Sanya was in the laundry block when the lights went out. Immediately, she cracked Garrick and shook him like a glowstick, producing light and generating a Squoatling mask.

"[Uh, you made me drop my Disney Planet mask, woman]{Garrick}," Garrick cried, upset.

“[In compensation, Emmett, I demand that you get on all fours and put on this leash]{Sanya Dreadflower},” Sanya demanded, bringing her ghostly lantern into the den.

"[Excuse me?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett put down his book, noticing the yellow light enter the room.

"[You technically owe me. Remember when you said that I owned you?]{Sanya Dreadflower}"

"[It was a slip of the tongue! Sheesh!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett folded his arms in the dark, feeling a tad bit embarrassed.

“[Bruh.]{Garrick}” Garrick remarked glowingly.

“[Well, I need to attach this light to something. A collar would work. So put it on.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya threw the collar at Emmett, holding Garrick in her left hand by the back of his vest.

Emmett jumped a little from the sudden weight on his chest. "[I'm already wearing a collar! What, you want me to unclothe like a filthy animal too?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett mentioned sarcastically.

“[Fine, just attach Garrick to your translator. I need some help to fix the lights.]{Sanya Dreadflower}”

"[I'll wear the leash just because you asked so nicely.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett slipped off the sofa onto his hooves, feeling a little strange. "[I'm going to have to get used to this.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[That's a good boy. Get over here]{Sanya Dreadflower}," Sanya mocked. For some reason, Emmett obeyed without resistance, crawling over to his apparent master.

“[Wear this.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya handed Emmett Garrick. Emmett attached the leash to his translator and gave Garrick the other end of it.

"[I hate this. Walk me.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett scratched his ear with his digits. Not his back hoof, you freak.

“[You’ve got mail!]{Garrick}” Garrick’s eyes rectangularized and a letter ejected out of his mouth.

“[Hmm. It looks like it’s from Squosafina. Guess it’s for you, Emmett.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya opens it and holds it to Emmett’s face, because Emmett is currently on all fours.

"[Okay, I must be flipping dreaming.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett bites onto the letter, keeping it in his mouth.

“[Well, if this is a dream, why are you dreaming about this? Being walked in the park by your friends?]{Sanya Dreadflower}” The backdrop of the ship slips away, replaced by a beautiful park.

Emmett spit out the letter, checking it out. Of course, it was from his hallucinated wife. "[Squem, meet me at the park in a few minutes. I have a gift for you.]{Josephine}" the letter read. Emmett sighed. "[I really wish she existed.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett got a little accustomed to being on all fours. "[Also, Sanya, I think Seth might have made me watch some old Earth movies. Or I watched some porn. Or it's a secret fetish of mine. I dunno.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He was surprisingly comfortable.

“[Then why are we here? Unless you have some repressed feelings for me and the Ghost, I’d say there are more things at play here.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya pulled out a small ball, throwing it in front of her. “[Care to fetch?]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya threw the ball at an awkward angle, keeping Emmett from feasibly getting it. The leash extended as far as Emmett chased the ball, however, and eventually, Emmett came back with a frisbee.

"[Here, Squom]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett spit out. Clearly, Sanya's interrogation was not working so well. "[I mean, Sanya. You know that I don't want to have anything romantic with either of you. I just feel free, you know? Free from grass. Free from social bonds. Whatever. It doesn't matter. Now give me a belly rub.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

“[Good Job!]{Garrick}”, Garrick said in a robotic, but also obnoxious voice.

“[Very well. I just figured you might know about your dreams the best.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya pushed Emmett on his back and reached down to give him a belly rub.

"[Sanya, this is the only time of day that I'm genuinely happy. Let me be.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

“[Squoatling!]{Garrick}” Garrick’s hands morphed into disgustingly humanoid hands and pointed to the approaching Squosafina, who was wearing a veil. Emmett peered over at the other Squoatling and he looked paranoid and upset at the same time.

“[Wait, before you start your big day, wouldn’t it be better to relieve yourself?]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya pointed at a nearby flower field, and released her grip on the leash. “[Wouldn’t want you peeing on the bride.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Emmett shivered, wanting to stay away from the approaching bride.

"[Yeah, uh… I'm going to piss, Josephine. Let me be back.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett quickly ran over to the flower field and whipped out a glow stick from his pants, urinating out from it. As the glowing urine hit the soil, a small seed began to grow and grow.

"[Hey, little buddy. Do you see her coming over here?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett tilted his head at the little seed, trying to hide from someone who would never find him.

“[She no longer exists. It’s just us now]{Emmett's Bud},” the bud whispered.

"[Thank Squoat. I want to get away from that GUY. Llamanians really got me on edge. I don't know what is or what isn't real sometimes.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett held himself, falling to the dirt below. He was freezing. He had no idea why, but he really was afraid of something, as if his withdrawals were trying to force something out of his body from his dreamscape.

“[Squoat? No, I am not your god. I'm you, Emmett.]{Emmett's Bud}” The flower bloomed in front of Emmett’s eyes, revealing Emmett’s face wrapped in Garrick’s mask.

“[You.]{Garrick}” Garrick beeped, and then flickered. Emmett was confused. Why would he be dreaming of Garrick as a flower in the first place? It made sense for his face to be there, but why combined with Garrick? No offense to him, of course.

"[I don't understand. Everything's getting really fuzzy. Is this a trick?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He felt the flower's face to see if Squosafina was in there.

“[It’s simple, Emmett. So simple. I’m better.]{Emmett's Bud}” The plant’s face morphed into various shapes. The park scenery collapsed around them. A loud droning noise envelops the void they now occupy. “[Release the bees.]{Emmett's Bud}” Emmett's mouth was forced open, his control over this lucid dream slowly fading. He was bleating, trying to close his jaw to stop the swarm of bees from entering. Emmett turned to the ghost attached to him for help, only to find that Garrick was also turned into a rather handsome bee.

“[Hey, if you’re not going to tap that goat back there, I’ll do it for you. I’m sure she won’t notice the difference]{Garrick},” the bee says with a wink. Emmett is somehow able to kick his jaw closed with his powerful leg muscles.

"[I can't tap her. She's not real. She's a product of my sin. Now get away from me!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett forced himself up and pushed the flower over. Suddenly, he was pushed back, the scenery around him shifting, and he landed in a patch of grass. Emmett was shrunk down to the size of an ant. The bees, now fleas, all crawled out of him. Naturally, Emmett grabbed a part of grass and stared at it, ignoring the fleas crawling from his pores. He was to make a decision. Should he take it? He was troubled, clearly.

“[EMMETT]{Sanya Dreadflower},” a booming voice rang through the air, accompanied by loud stomping. A green finger placed itself by the Squoatling, beckoning him to hop on. “[YOU’RE NOT CONSIDERING IT, ARE YOU?]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Emmett got onto the finger, holding the grass tightly.

"[Sanya, why am I so miserable? The galaxy hates me. Even my dreams do.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

“[There is no one quite like you; I think you are wonderful!]{Garrick}” Garrick reappeared as himself. “[Thinking of you and how special you are. Hang in there!]{Garrick}” These lines repeated over and over, echoing over.

“[IT’S ALRIGHT, EMMETT. THIS IS SIMPLY A BAD DREAM, CAUSED BY WITHDRAWALS. IT MAY BE HARD AT FIRST, BUT BETTERING YOURSELF IS NEVER EASY.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” The giant Floran lifted her finger to eye level, walking slowly while talking to Emmett.

"[There's just a lot of repressed feelings I have that I'm too embarrassed to let out]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett muttered. He tore a small part of the grass out and threw the rest to the side, sticking it within his mouth. "[I don't think anyone understands that I do need this stuff to live as well. They've been on my ass twenty-four-seven. And not in the good way either.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett grows angry at this conflict. He mutates into his Crave form and his body lengthens into a caterpillar.

“[THE ONLY GOOD WAY TO BE ON SOMEONE’S ASS IS THE GAY WAY.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya imparts this information upon her newly caterpilled friend.

"[Hey. You don't judge me, I don't judge you. If it's with a girl, it's not gay.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

“[BUT CAN YOU JUDGE YOU?]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Emmett started to nibble into Sanya's finger, tasting a delicious mixture of cucumber and aloe. He was eating to get these questions out of his mind, to avoid his eventual judgment.

"[Mmh mhhf. Mmmmmmh. Wah wah waaaah!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett said through a full mouth of Sanya finger. With a quick slap and an “[OW!]{Emmett Tawfeek}”, he was launched off of Sanya’s hand back into the park. The scenery changed again—all the buildings were now sinking into the ground, with Emmett suspended on a raft. His caterpillar abdomen had shortened significantly, and he was now back to his normal body length. Squosafina approached him, walking on the sinking ground. Her veil covered her head as she neared the raft.

"[Squem, I don't know if you're listening to me, but I am real. You're just hallucinating]{Josephine}," Emmett scooted to the back of the raft, panicking.

"[Get away from me! I know… how to use this!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett, planning on holding a Maggo Pistol, was actually aiming a Pulse-Master 90210™, essentially a dildo, at her face. He dropped the toy as soon as he realized, and his collar suddenly tightened around his neck. Squosafina pushed her veil aside, revealing Jess’s face. She smiled at Emmett, before her face melted and formed into Seth’s. “[AAAAAAAAAAAAH! SETH?!]{Emmett Tawfeek}”

“[I FUCKED YOUR MOM, GOATBOY! HOW DO YOU FEEL ABOUT THAT?!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}” Seth threw a bridal bouquet at Emmett, poking him with thorns, before the elf condensed into a giant marble. “[***I*** DID IT!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}” The giant marble began to tumble and roll quickly towards Emmett!

“[ALL!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}” The marble approached the raft.

“[DAY!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}” Almost there…!

“[LOOOOLOLOOLOLONG!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}”

As soon as the marbled Seth rolled up to Emmett's crotch, Emmett immediately woke up. He was panting, his fur matted with sweat from his rush of adrenaline. He felt his heart as he tried to calm down. What was the reasoning of all of this? He tried to scoot himself up so that he was leaning against his bedrest, but Jess's grasp made him stop.

"[Jess? Why are you here?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett softly inquired. Jess's bed was shipped to the crew a few hours before they went to bed, and Emmett took the liberty of getting it set up for her. She definitely knew this, and Emmett even saw her sleep in it earlier. He was too tired to get her to move, and he honestly did not care. Despite feeling so startled from his dream, he was able to cozy himself again within a few minutes. The ship was safe, he was safe, and Jess was safe. He assumed everyone else was fine.

"[Emmett, are you okay?]{Garrick}" Garrick phased into the room, having heard his muffled bleats of distress.

"[I'm fine, Garrick. Just… restless.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[You and Jessica aren't doing anything wrong, right? We just got her bed in and made.]{Garrick}"

"[No. We're okay. I guess she just crawled in here with me while I was asleep. I did fall asleep pretty early, anyhow.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Be sure to take a shower when you wake up. You're wet.]{Garrick}" Garrick left the room, and Emmett fell back asleep within a few minutes.
